name: 06-09-postgres-catalog-access-distinct-order-fix
title: Postgres catalog access DISTINCT order fix
creator: Latias94
notes: Completed PostgreSQL catalog_access DISTINCT/ORDER BY compatibility fix. Removed redundant DISTINCT from the Postgres accessible media item query and selected a typed sort_id for the relation-item DISTINCT query so PostgreSQL can order by selected expressions. Updated nako-db database guidelines with the PostgreSQL SELECT DISTINCT ordering rule. Verified with cargo fmt --all, cargo check -p nako-db --tests, NAKO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=postgres://nako:nako@127.0.0.1:28841/nako cargo nextest run -p nako-db postgres_catalog_access_contract --run-ignored ignored-only --no-fail-fast, cargo nextest run -p nako-db catalog_access --no-fail-fast, and git diff --check.
